name: a dated quote hangs over a figure at a candlelit desk
looks: A silhouetted figure sits at a desk by a single candle, writing. Above the scene a short, dismissive quote fades in, in a quiet italic voice, with its date and occasion set underneath in a smaller plain face.
build: The quote fades/rises in on power2.out in an italic or handwritten-adjacent face; the attribution line, smaller and plainer, fades in just after at lower contrast, same two-voice split as dual-voice-type; the candle's glow flickers gently throughout on a seeded noise.
sound: A quiet room tone, a soft page-turn or pen-scratch under the figure's writing, nothing under the quote itself.
prompt: Hold a silhouetted figure writing at a candlelit desk while a short, dismissive quote fades in above the scene in a quiet italic voice, its date and occasion settling underneath in a smaller plain face a beat later, to let history's own scepticism speak in two distinct registers.
